dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Single prominent 'O' shaped annulus in the upper-left quadrant with a sharp high-contrast light-gray perimeter; adjacent mid-section contains multiple interlocking 'C' and irregular polygonal rings with jagged, high-intensity borders.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous high-intensity white clusters scattered across the right-posterior region, characterized by diffuse edges and a lack of internal topological gradients compared to the anterior annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroid of the upper-left 'O' annulus forms an obtuse triangular relationship with the centroid of a prominent 'C' structure in the lower-mid region and a high-intensity blob in the upper-right section.
